summary: The MaintProgramProfileDescription class is a user control that manages the display and editing of program profiles within a grid view and form view. It leverages various ASP.NET controls to facilitate CRUD operations through a user interface, and handles data retrieval through ObjectDataSource controls.
purpose: The purpose of the MaintProgramProfileDescription control is to handle the display, addition, modification, and deletion of program profile details in a user-friendly manner, utilizing a grid and form views for data visualization and interaction.

actors.name: User
actors.role: Interacts with the interface to view, add, edit, or delete program profiles.

workflows.name: Data Selection
steps: On selecting data, verify the visibility of the control.
Pass UserSession and ProgramID as input parameters.
Cancel selection if control is not visible.

workflows.name: Row Data Binding
steps: Bind data to rows in the grid.
Set up buttons based on editability.
Adjust visibility of description panels based on data.

workflows.name: Row Command Execution
steps: Handle row commands: edit, add, delete.
Switch to edit mode and bind data for editing.

workflows.name: Data Addition
steps: Bind form view to capture new data.

business_rules.rule: Cancel data selection if the control is not visible.
Only show empty data panel if grid is empty and screen is editable.

validations.validation: Ensure 'SortOrder' is not null; default to -1 if empty.

conditions.condition: When in edit mode, set up edit and delete buttons.

system_behavior.behavior: Auto-generate fields are transferred to code-behind files for modifications.
Redirects to MaintProgramProfile page with updated parameters after operations.

dependencies.dependency: Grid and data binding directly depend on UserSession details and ProgramID.

exceptions.exception: JavaScript errors related to event validation may occur due to use of EmptyDataTemplate.
